pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "das Wetter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fog
   B. weather
   C. snow
   D. rain

2. What does "der Teller" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. radio
   B. knife
   C. chair
   D. plate

3. Which German word means "May"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. Januar
   B. September
   C. Mai
   D. November

4. In "Fischers Fritz fischt frische Fische", which sound repeats? (1 mark)
   A. m
   B. k
   C. f
   D. z

5. Which day means "the middle of the week"? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. Freitag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Sonntag

6. Which food group does "die Banane" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. das Gemüse
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Obst

7. Which food group does "die Tomate" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Obst
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Fleisch

8. Which German word or phrase means "toe"? (1 mark)
   A. der Zeh
   B. der Bauch
   C. der Finger
   D. der Fuß

9. How is "w" pronounced in "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. like English w
   B. like b
   C. like f
   D. like v

10. What does "das Bein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eye
   B. leg
   C. arm
   D. hand

11. What does "das Zimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. table
   B. room
   C. fork
   D. fridge

12. A classmate asks "Wie heißt du?" What is being asked? (1 mark)
   A. Your age
   B. Your name
   C. Where you live
   D. How you feel

13. What does "die Milch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. carrot
   B. mango
   C. milk
   D. cocoa

14. What does "das Fenster" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bed
   B. window
   C. bathroom
   D. table

15. Which German word means "old"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. fleißig
   B. alt
   C. lustig
   D. klein

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German words with der, die or das for: leg, house. (2 marks)

17. Write a sentence about your favourite room in German. (2 marks)

18. Unscramble the words: SICHT and TETB. Write them with their articles. (2 marks)

19. Give two reasons why imitating a teacher or a recording helps when learning German sounds. (2 marks)

20. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back, sugar, child. (5 marks)

21. Explain the trick to decide between ie and ei when you write. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — weather
   das Wetter means weather.

2. D — plate
   der Teller means plate.

3. C — Mai
   May in German is Mai.

4. C — f
   Every word begins with f or sch or f.

5. C — Mittwoch
   Mittwoch comes from the middle of the week.

6. D — das Obst
   die Banane belongs to das Obst.

7. A — das Gemüse
   die Tomate belongs to das Gemüse.

8. A — der Zeh
   toe in German is der Zeh.

9. D — like v
   German w sounds like v, so Wasser is VAS-ser.

10. B — leg
   das Bein means leg.

11. B — room
   das Zimmer means room.

12. B — Your name
   Wie heißt du? means What is your name?

13. C — milk
   die Milch means milk.

14. B — window
   das Fenster means window.

15. B — alt
   old in German is alt.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Bein, das Haus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mein Lieblingszimmer ist die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with article.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: We hear the right sounds and practise them again and again, so our mouth learns them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

20. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken, der Zucker, das Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: If you hear ee, write ie; if you hear eye, write ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
